svg.text: QuotaCo exterior prop family · bike rack + street light second pass
REVIEW ONLY · two open carriers isolated from the otherwise accepted first-pass hybrid
functional noun first · hybrid material grammar second
BIKE RACK · restore a plan-projected locking/parking read

text.tspan: Repeated pale loops remain, but the hook-like tops and decorative
edge compete with the rack noun.
Three broad inverted-U locking hoops and six explicit ground mounts.
Strongest conventional rack read with the quietest far silhouette.
Four plan-projected wheel slots terminate in one service rail.
Clear parking function up close, but the narrow slots compress at far zoom.
Three lock posts and approach channels make the interaction face explicit.
Most QuotaCo-specific, but risks reading as scooter or charging infrastructure.

svg.text: STREET LIGHT · make the emitting head own the silhouette

text.tspan: The centered cap, stacked coral collars, and short mast read closer
to a signal or decorated bollard.
One bent mast carries a broad, shielded lamp with a visible luminous
underside.
Most immediate street-light read while retaining a compact 1×1 base.
A centered mast and two opposing heads establish parking-lot coverage.
Strong facility read, though the wide top becomes busier near walls.
A low shielded cap and glowing core favor paths and employee spaces.
Warmest campus character, but less clearly a street light at far zoom.

svg.text: accepted 112u wall · character ×0.65 · prop multipliers independent

text.tspan: Rack remains plan-projected and inside its preserved 2×1 occupancy.
Three wide negative spaces survive far zoom; mounts read as ground hardware, not feet.
The context-only bicycle meets a hoop without becoming part of the prop source.
The offset lamp head owns the light silhouette; coral is confined to its access panel.
The 1×1 light base and interaction clearance remain unchanged beside the wall and crowd.

svg.text: Dashed = preserved occupancy. Bicycle and light cone are evaluation context only.
No source SVG creation · no template/export/Unity change · no commit
Approval target: choose or revise one rack and one light direction before updating the consolidated exterior family.
Production pixels, genuine editable SVGs, template registration, exports, and Unity integration remain held.
